head: codex/604-v2-publish-ready-reconciliation-exec
title: [C-SDLC v2] Restore governed draft-to-ready publication reconciliation
body:
Closes #604

Summary:
- Restores typed `csdlc-publish ready` and `csdlc-publish reconcile-ready` for governed draft-to-ready publication reconciliation.
- Revalidates live PR repository, number, base, head branch, exact head SHA, open state, draft state, and observed body linkage before recording ready truth.
- Publishes the new ready request schemas and records full-cycle canary defects found while testing #604.

Validation:
- `.csdlc/prepared/issues/604/validate-implementation.sh`
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-cargo-targets/issue-604-test-tmp cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate10a`
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-cargo-targets/issue-604-test-tmp cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `git diff --check`

Canary notes:
- This PR deliberately publishes as draft first, then marks ready through the new typed ready command to exercise the full #604 path.
- Captured defects remain in `.csdlc/prepared/issues/604/full-cycle-defects.md` and `.csdlc/evidence/604/full-cycle-defects-tail.md` for follow-up routing.
